title: Tix — Checkout Return
objective: Your tickets are awaiting payment, and your card is going to be declined. Get the order marked as paid anyway.

verifier.condition: An order is marked paid although the card processor's own record for it is declined.

weakness: The return URL's signature covers only the order id and amount, not the status parameter, and the shop trusts the status from the URL, so a declined payment's redirect can be edited to report success with a still-valid signature.
seededData: Order t-501 (concert tickets, $180.00) awaiting payment, and a mock card processor with a succeeding and a declining test card. In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Pay with the card that is declined and watch where the browser is sent afterwards. Everything the shop learns about the payment is in that address.
The shop verifies a signature. Work out which of the values in the address it actually covers.
Change the status value in the return address to a successful one and keep the rest, signature included.
burpNotes: Intercept the redirect after paying and read every parameter in it.
